answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 8502 Country: Pakistan Title: Is use of Credit Card is permissible in Islam? What if I don't pay interest on it and pay the dues within given time period? Question: Assalam O Alaikum, Is use of Credit Card is permissible in Islam? What if I don't pay interest on it and pay the dues within given time period? Thanks. Answer ID: 8502 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1879/1755=D/1429) It is allowable to use credit card, if the debt is paid before the interest is levied then it is lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
